summary: GitHub watches notify seats when an open pull request changes head, becomes draft or ready, or enters or leaves its merge queue, including while checks are pending.

replay.detail: No claim registry change; notifications use existing message claims and observation-based delivery keys.

schema.detail: No database or public client schema change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or claim registry digest changes.

compatibility.detail: Existing watches additionally deliver head, draft and queue-membership notifications. No API shape change. Older builds retain watches and messages but deliver only comments, reviews, checks and closures.

recovery.detail: Downgrading preserves declarations and messages; the additional event coverage ends on the older build.
